proof_object.actual_carrier: After exact-zero rows are omitted, saturating each nonzero z_j by t^ceil(log_2 A^2) removes exactly the t-supported primary parts. The radical lcm, intersected with rad(Q), is R_perp_Q.
proof_object.density: Any o(n)-depth portfolio is zero rate. Xi_Q>=eta log b requires at least (eta/2+o(1))n distinct active depths.
proof_object.first_hit: Successive squarefree novelty quotients D_j are pairwise coprime and multiply exactly to R_perp_Q; Xi_Q=sum log D_j.
proof_object.mesoscopic: The union of p<=A has Chebyshev mass O(A)=o(log b). Since |z_j|<A^2, the >A part of each D_j is one or a single prime.
proof_object.quotient_coordinate: In the target coordinate ring z=z_m is free and kappa=kappa_lower-z, t=c-kappa_lower+z.
proof_object.resultant_barrier: The lower t-polynomial is primitive. Gauss content gives ((b,Delta,z):t^infinity) intersect Z=(b); the raw union product ideal is contained in this component and has the same constant contraction.
proof_object.scope: The raw product has exact-zero components; the theorem does not bound the specialization-first growing first-hit average. H_Q, squarefull excess, Gamma_Q, and the half-bound stay open.
